home.seo_desc: Easily and freely create your CV, cover letter, and portfolio with our intuitive tools. Simple, fast, and professional.
home.subtitle: Stand out with professional and modern templates. Get a 100% ATS Score with our live gauge and export to High Quality PDF for free.
home.why_title: Why choose Mon CV Go to create a free CV online?
home.why_p1: Job searching is a crucial step in any professional's life. Whether you are a fresh graduate looking for your first job, or an experienced manager wishing to give a new boost to your career, your Curriculum Vitae (CV) is your passport to the interview. Mon CV Go was designed and developed to offer you the best free online CV creation experience.
home.news_title: New: Integrated AI Generation & ATS Score
home.news_p1: To optimize your chances when applying, Mon CV Go now integrates two practical tools:
home.news_ai_desc: Lacking inspiration? Click the suggestion button and let our tool help you phrase a catchy profile summary or detail your experiences with the right keywords.
home.news_ats_desc: Instantly discover the effectiveness of your CV! Our gauge calculates your score in real time and gives you precise recommendations (add skills, lengthen the description, etc.) to ensure you pass the filters of recruitment software (Applicant Tracking Systems).
home.ats_title: The importance of a modern and ATS-optimized CV template
home.ats_p1: Today, the majority of large companies and recruitment agencies use application tracking software, called ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems). These programs automatically scan your document for specific keywords even before a human recruiter lays eyes on it. Our CV templates have been designed not only to be aesthetically perfect, but above all to be readable and understandable by these algorithms.
home.pillars_title: Our 3 pillars for a successful CV:
home.pillar_1_desc: A respected information hierarchy with professional fonts that guide the recruiter's eye towards your key skills.
home.pillar_2_desc: Well-defined sections (Profile, Experiences, Education, Skills) that you can easily customize and order.
home.pillar_3_desc: Unlike Word format, PDF export ensures that your layout will remain exactly the same, regardless of the computer or smartphone used by the recruiter.
home.more_title: More than just an online CV generator
home.more_p1: We know that a CV alone is sometimes not enough. That's why Mon CV Go also includes a Cover Letter creation module and an innovative tool to generate a Visual Portfolio. For web, design, architecture, or communication professions, being able to show concrete achievements in one click is an undeniable advantage.
home.more_p2: All your data remains private and secure. Your document is generated directly in your web browser, which ensures that your personal information is not stored unsecurely on third-party servers. This is Mon CV Go's commitment: to provide you with a free, fast service that respects your privacy.
home.steps_title: How to create a professional CV in 3 simple steps?
home.step_1_desc: Explore our gallery of professional designs and select the one that matches your industry.
home.step_2_desc: Add your experiences, degrees, and skills via our simple interface. Watch the preview update in real time.
home.step_3_desc: One click is enough to get your final document in High Definition PDF, ready to be sent to recruiters.
home.portfolio_title: The advantage of an online Portfolio
home.portfolio_p1: More and more recruiters are looking for visual proof of your skills. A classic CV is essential, but a Portfolio makes the difference. Our exclusive tool allows you to transform your projects into an elegant presentation site in PDF format. It is the secret weapon of designers, developers, architects, and marketing professionals to concretely illustrate their added value.
home.link_tips: Discover all our expert tips for writing a perfect CV →
home.faq_1_a: Yes, absolutely. Unlike many sites that ask you to pay at the final download step, Mon CV Go is a completely free service, supported by advertising. You can generate, edit, and download as many resumes as you want without ever having to take out your credit card.
home.faq_2_q: What is an ATS system and why is my score important?
home.faq_2_a: An ATS (Applicant Tracking System) is software used by recruiters to automatically sort received resumes. If your resume is not optimized for these programs (wrong keywords, complex structure, unreadable format), it will be rejected before a human even reads it. Our ATS Score gauge ensures your resume meets all necessary technical criteria.
home.faq_3_a: Protecting your privacy is our top priority. We designed Mon CV Go to work locally in your browser. This means that all the information you enter (name, address, experience) never leaves your computer and is not stored on our servers.
home.faq_4_q: Which download format should I choose for my resume?
home.faq_4_a: We always recommend the PDF format. This format ensures that the layout, fonts, and overall design of your document will remain exactly the same, regardless of the device (computer, tablet, smartphone) or operating system the recruiter uses to open it.
home.faq_5_q: How many pages should a resume ideally be?
home.faq_5_a: The standard is generally one page, especially if you have less than 10 years of experience. However, for very senior or technical profiles, a two-page resume is perfectly acceptable to recruiters, provided every piece of information is relevant.
home.faq_6_q: Should I include a photo on my resume?
home.faq_6_a: In the UK and USA, it is strictly prohibited to include a photo to avoid discrimination. In France and many other countries, a professional and smiling photo is appreciated and humanizes your application. Always check the local conventions of the country you are applying in.
home.guide_title: Step-by-Step Guide to a Winning Resume
home.guide_1_desc: Your name, contact details, a link to your portfolio or LinkedIn, and above all a clear profile title followed by a short 3-line paragraph summarizing your added value.
home.guide_2_desc: List them in reverse chronological order. Use the Action-Result method to prove your impact with precise figures rather than a simple list of tasks.
home.guide_3_desc: Only keep relevant degrees. Separate your Hard Skills (tools, software) from your Soft Skills (leadership, empathy) to make reading easier.
home.sector_1_desc: Opt for a clean layout with a sidebar to highlight your programming languages, frameworks, and GitHub links.
home.sector_2_desc: Dare to use a touch of color and more assertive typography. It's an opportunity to demonstrate your aesthetic sensibility while maintaining a readable structure.
home.sector_3_desc: Go for absolute minimalism. A classic design (black and white, serif) that puts all the focus on your quantified achievements and leadership.

home.job_space_desc: Track your applications with a Kanban board, analyze job offers, and calculate your market salary. Everything you need to land your dream job, in one place.

about.seo_desc: Discover the story of Mon CV Go, the free and privacy-friendly CV generator.
about.p1: The idea behind Mon CV Go is simple: offer a powerful resume creation tool without complex subscriptions or hidden costs. Too many candidates waste precious time on platforms that turn out to be paid at the time of download. We want to empower job seekers by providing them with professional-grade tools, accessible to everyone.
about.feat_1_desc: No hidden subscription, no watermark. You generate, you download. It's that simple.
about.feat_2_desc: Your data stays in your browser. Nothing is sent to our servers. You are the sole master of your information.
about.feat_3_desc: Built with the latest web technologies (React, Tailwind) to offer you a smooth, fast and bug-free experience.
about.feat_4_desc: No waiting time. Your document is generated live with every change you make.
about.story_p1: Mon CV Go was born from the desire to create an independent alternative to large paid resume generators. The goal of this project is to offer a smooth and secure platform to help you apply with more peace of mind. Every month, thousands of users trust our tool to structure their career path and land interviews. Our team continuously strives to improve the platform by following the latest trends in recruitment and human resources.
